title: Ordinary scalar presentations of the ordered supported-product objects
statement: Fix $P$ and a positive coefficient level $n+1$, written with predecessor $n$. Use the actual coefficient unit $U$, ordered supported-product target $T_r$ and shifted finite line $L$ of [cor-pur-affine-space-zero-section-purity], the ordinary line $A(r)[2r]$ of [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows], and realization of [def-pur-finite-orientation-scalar-presentation]. Define $U\simeq\nu^*A[0]$ by the exact single-object comparison. Define the ordered-action presentation inductively by this unit comparison and the canonical site tensorator at each successor, followed by the published zero and successor equations for the ordinary root tensor powers. This gives $T_r\simeq\nu^*(A(r)[2r])$ without choosing a frame or orientation. Under these presentations define the quotient map on $U$ by the ordinary scalar-unit map, with its single/unit comparisons. The case $r=0$ is the coefficient unit.
